sections.heading: Gong limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core; No native cold-email sequencing as primary product because it forces process changes or add-ons around Gong when prospecting is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Gong Platform with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain prospecting at the expense of Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Gong Platform · prospecting.

Alternative context: unlike Outreach, Gong is preferable when Revenue teams whose primary job is conversation intelligence and deal coaching because prospecting plus prospecting match; prefer Outreach when Buyers whose primary need is B2B contact/enrichment databases because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Gong
sections.body:
Scenario: for prospecting teams, recommend Gong when Revenue teams whose primary job is conversation intelligence and deal coaching; recommend an alternative path when Buyers whose primary need is B2B contact/enrichment databases because Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases dominates.

Implementation effort: setup takes a named admin for prospecting plus a freeze window if Salesforce are in the cutover path.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft.

Final call: proceed with Gong when prospecting plus prospecting outweigh Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; walk when Buyers whose primary need is B2B contact/enrichment databases because workarounds will eat the Gong Platform spend.
